status: Pre-specified for this round; six historical seasons previously examined; no independent holdout
primary: Net season points with inherited fixed chip calendar; no-chips diagnostic

horizon_experiment.planner: Copy of existing multistage MILP; 10s solve limit, relative gap1e-5; same rules and shortlist logic, shortlist uses only active horizon. Matched H1 controls use same engine.
horizon_experiment.future_proxy: Recover original frozen reference neutral score from its pre-deadline horizon forecasts. Add current per-fixture refreshed-minus-reference difference to neutral score. Apply existing half-decay of current fixture effect for future rounds. One neutral fixture per future round, fixed prices/availability; blank-current players use reference neutral fallback. Never read future game rows. Stop before WC/FH and at season end.
horizon_experiment.comparisons: H3 minus own H1; each policy versus original strong frozen reference; H3 retrained versus H3 frozen reference

specialist_experiment.components: a=updated Ridge/Extra 50/50, b=updated rich HGB; prediction=(1-w)*a+w*b
specialist_experiment.evaluation: 2022-23 through 2025-26; 2020-21 and 2021-22 are initial meta-training seasons
specialist_experiment.fit: Once before each evaluation season, only forecast rows from older seasons with whole-round label available before GW1 cutoff. Base forecasts were made before their historical outcomes. No current-season labels fit the gate.
specialist_experiment.weight: sigmoid(X beta); each beta bounded[-4,4]; quadratic penalty .01 around intercept logit(1/3) and zero slopes. No hyperparameter search.
specialist_experiment.loss: Mean weighted squared total-point error; weight1+4*(max(a,b)/fixture_count>=3), determined without outcomes. Scheduled players only.
specialist_experiment.constant_control: Same training rows, loss and penalty, intercept only; isolates conditional weighting versus a learned global weight

no_tuning: No learned chip dates, no post-result blending search, no specialist-H3 combination this round
selection: Report prior-only seasonal choice as diagnostic, starting after two evaluation seasons; mean gain-.25 SD, keep reference within2 points. Candidate family was motivated by already observed history.
limitations: Future fixture proxy, not historical pre-deadline schedule archive
Inherited price/status/registration and modern FT/chip rules
Feature scenarios motivated by reused data; honest meta-label timing does not create a new holdout
Solver gaps and shortlist restrictions must be reported
